resources.string: The ANC capability provided by this app is completely different from the solution fine-tuned by the official headphone and earbud manufacturers, and results may be phone-dependent.
Use at your own risk only.
Connect your headphones before switching on.
Microphone permission is required to listen to the ambient noise.
Connect headphones first. Without them the anti-noise would play from the speaker and cause feedback.
Could not start the audio engine on this device.
Keep ANC running when the app is closed or the screen is off. A notification is shown while it runs.
Only low frequencies can be cancelled. The media volume also scales the anti-noise. Start low and raise the strength carefully.
Learns steady, periodic noise such as fan hum and compensates the loop latency. Needs calibration.
Simple inverted copy of the noise. Only works when the latency is very low.

Hold one ear cup of your headphones tightly against the phone microphone (do NOT wear them), then press the button. After 3 seconds a short noise burst is played to measure the exact loop latency. Recalibrate whenever you change headphones or connection type.
Measuring… keep the ear cup on the microphone.
Could not open the audio path.
The burst was not heard clearly. Hold the ear cup closer to the microphone, raise the media volume a bit and try again.
If the hum is still audible, slowly move the trim while ANC is on and listen for the quietest point.
Not calibrated. Open Settings and run the latency calibration for best results.
